subject.title: fix(infra): scope Windows path realpath caches

question: Should OpenClaw accept operation-scoped realpath caches inside plugin and sandbox containment checks once the duplicate export is fixed and proof is refreshed?
rationale: The proposed cache lifetime is narrower than a process-wide cache but still changes security-boundary validation behavior, so automation should not make the final acceptance call.

options.title: Accept operation-scoped caches after repair
options.body: Fix the duplicate export, refresh proof, and accept per-operation cache lifetimes as the security/performance tradeoff for these paths.

options.title: Require non-containment optimization only
options.body: Reject caching inside containment checks and pursue performance improvements in non-security-boundary discovery paths instead.

options.title: Pause for narrower design
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers define the exact cache lifetime contract they want for plugin and sandbox path checks.

recommendation.title: Accept operation-scoped caches after repair
recommendation.body: Fix the duplicate export, refresh proof, and accept per-operation cache lifetimes as the security/performance tradeoff for these paths.
